'''Gus Treta''' was the outermost of the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SOF" /> It was orbited by the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]], which circled the moon five times a day.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Make everything from the cockpit back black, including the S-foils, and give me a green-and-gold check pattern on the front fuselage.''"<br />"''I don't recognize the color scheme.''"<br />"''No reason you should. Back when my parents operated a fueling station at Gus Treta, my father was saving up to buy the station and start his own chain. The green, gold, and black were going to be the colors he used for the logo and the uniforms. Your colors tie you back to your home, Corran's do the same thing for him, and I imagine the same is true for everyone else. Mine will tie me to the home I should have had.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CorelliaMoon.jpg|120px|thumb|One of Corellia's moons]]
[[File:CorelliaMoons.jpg|150px|thumb|The other two moons of Corellia]]
Gus Treta first appeared as one of the three moons of Corellia in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> It was first identified in the sourcebook ''[[Suns of Fortune]]''.<ref name="SOF" />
